messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 1.2-0 released
messages.body_plain:
Version 1.2-0 of the NMOF package is available from
http://enricoschumann.net/R/packages/NMOF/index.htm

If you use GitHub, you can get the source also from
https://github.com/enricoschumann/NMOF

NEWS entries since version 1.0:

v1.2-0  (2017-09-13)

  o new functions 'bundFuture' and
    'bundFutureImpliedRate', for computing theoretical
    futures prices and implied repo rates, respectively

v1.1-0  (2017-05-01)

  o new function 'divRatio', for computing the
    diversification ratio


-- 
Enrico Schumann
Lucerne, Switzerland
http://enricoschumann.net
